entities.summary: Roman, a notable figure in the history of Serbia, associated with Roman Serbia & Constantine the Great (500 BCE–15 BCE). Preceded by Celtic Scordisci & Roman Conquest. Their legacy influenced Constantine the Great born at Naissus (Niš) and Sirmium serves as one of four Tetrarchic capitals.
